patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Squarespace's shape. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than Shopware's shape. Workflow advantage: Shopware leans catalog-management, wholesale-b2b; Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Shopware and Squarespace share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote.; Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees .
- Company-size focus: Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Shopware-leaning catalog-management, wholesale-b2b vs Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume.

Limitations — Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting; Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · Avoid Shopware if you actually need Squarespace's motion (Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanc)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
